items.title: 川普正在考慮禁止柴油出口，但他表示這可能會對汽油產生「負面影響」。
items.titleEn: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline
items.titleZh: 川普正在考慮禁止柴油出口，但他表示這可能會對汽油產生「負面影響」。
items.summaryEn: Trump recently said he was "very seriously" considering a diesel export ban, despite warnings from the U.S. oil industry that doing so would raise prices.
items.summaryZh: 儘管美國石油業警告稱，禁止柴油出口會推高油價，但川普最近表示，他正在「非常認真地」考慮禁止柴油出口。

items.title: 聯準會首選的通膨指標顯示，8月核心通膨率為3.0%，遠低於預期。
items.titleEn: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
items.titleZh: 聯準會首選的通膨指標顯示，8月核心通膨率為3.0%，遠低於預期。
items.summaryEn: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊共識預測，個人消費支出物價指數整體年增率預估為 3.7%，核心年增率預估為 3.3%。

items.summaryEn: Nvidia said the buyback boost marks the largest share repurchase authorization increase in history.

items.title: 隨著債券殖利率飆升，負債累累的人工智慧公司面臨更大的風險。

items.titleZh: 隨著債券殖利率飆升，負債累累的人工智慧公司面臨更大的風險。
items.summaryEn: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.

items.title: 川普和習近平結束國事訪問，這次訪問以作秀為主，實質內容較少。以下是主要要點。

items.summaryEn: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi went heavy on the ceremony and light on deliverables as they danced around Taiwan and Iran during two days in Washington.
items.summaryZh: 在華盛頓的兩天裡，川普總統和中國領導人習近平在圍繞台灣和伊朗問題進行磋商時，注重形式而缺乏實質成果。
